name: resolve
description: Host lookup that never blocks the caller's loop, one API on Linux, macOS and Windows: start, poll, take the addresses, drop to cancel. The system answers as it answers every program there: the C library's getaddrinfo on Linux and macOS, GetAddrInfoW on Windows, each on a thread of wait's, which signals the caller's poll when done. A lookup holds a thread while it runs, and one cancelled after it started runs on to the system's timeout.
